name: @intellectual-frontiers/gate
description: A policy gate: policies written as code over the subjects of a change (assets, resources, endpoints), evaluated on what a change adds or alters, with severities that block or warn, waivers that a person grants for a reason and a time, and a verdict that CI and a merge can act on, also as SARIF.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
